content: Go graceful shutdown consensus: signal.NotifyContext root ctx; errgroup.WithContext for workers; stop in reverse order of startup (listeners first, downstream/storage last); per-step timeout context (not the cancelled root); http.Server.Shutdown-style drain. Marmot ShutdownOrchestrator operationalizes this for clustered daemons; go-ultimate wiring-and-runtime.md mandates Wire() returning Runtime+units with a serve loop where first unit returning cancels the rest.
